title: A Black Box Made Less Opaque (part 2)
primary_claim: In GPT-2 Small, pretrained residual-stream SAE 'specialist' features are primarily selective for syntax/surface form rather than semantics (mean Jaccard similarity of only 0.13 among top-5 specialist features across matched surface-form variants of the same meaning), whereas the overall SAE activation profile across all 24,576 features clusters primarily by semantic topic (within-topic cosine similarity 0.50 vs cross-topic 0.14), suggesting a two-tier syntax/semantics representational structure.
quote: the overall mean Jaccard similarity was a very modest 0.13. This limited specialist feature overlap is indicative of syntax-focused specialist features.
metric: Jaccard similarity of top-5 specialist SAE features across matched surface forms; cosine similarity of overall SAE activation within-topic vs cross-topic
target_value: mean Jaccard similarity across surface forms = 0.13; within-topic cosine similarity = 0.50 vs cross-topic cosine similarity = 0.14
tolerance_rationale: unit-interval metric: 0.05 absolute; post reported no spread, tolerance is a guess

needed: hardcoded matched-pairs text dataset (Python/math/etc. surface-form variants), written in notebook cells

inspector_notes: Cleanest repo of the batch: exact pinned pip freeze, explicit CPU-only torch, a 124M-parameter model, and cached intermediate activations already committed. Trivially reproducible even without a GPU.
headline_artifact: Jaccard similarity of top-5 specialist SAE features across matched surface-form pairs, and within-topic vs. cross-topic cosine similarity of the full SAE activation vector, both computed directly in phase_2_semantics_vs_ideas_v2.ipynb.

extension.what_varies: nothing in the experiment: the author's local SAE cache (~/.cache/sae_lens/blocks.{6,8,10,11}.hook_resid_pre, an uncommitted artifact the notebook loads from disk) is populated from the public sae-lens release gpt2-small-res-jb; packages resolved at the repo's own pins (sae-lens 6.18.0, transformer-lens 2.16.1, transformers 4.57.1, torch 2.9.0) frozen at 2026-02-18
extension.rationale: parent ledgered env ('legacy sae-lens id 11-res-jb removed'). Reading the notebook: the KeyError comes from a silent skip in the disk-loading loop, not from the registry -- the row is an uncommitted-artifact (data) case misfiled as version drift. Tests whether fetching the artifact yields the headline (Jaccard 0.13; within-topic cosine 0.50 vs cross 0.14).
